The First Standing Stone — Runes spiral up the weathered monolith, half-buried in drifting sand. They seem to shift meaning depending on the angle of the sun.
The Salt Hand Toll — Riders in salt-crusted leathers block the road, spears loose in their hands. Their leader grins, missing two teeth, and names a price for passage.
Steel on the Sand — The Salt Hand Riders close in, blades drawn, unwilling to let anyone pass without paying one way or another.
Aligning the Stones — A ring of standing stones surrounds a sunken basin. Rees's notes, old lore, or sheer force might reveal the path down into the dark beneath them.
The Bonewind Rises — A wall of stinging sand rolls across the Trace, swallowing the horizon and the standing stones alike. Voices seem to whisper in the wind.
Rees's Abandoned Camp — A collapsed tent and a cold firepit mark where the cartographer made his last camp. His journal lies half-buried, pages fluttering.

The Stone Guardians — Armor clatters upright with no one inside it, and shadows peel from the walls with hungry, reaching edges.
